notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the standard federation MOM save-status response. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time settings. It joins two federates, invokes queryFederationSaveStatus outside a save operation, and verifies that the standard callback reports both members with NO_SAVE_IN_PROGRESS under HLA_EVOKED and HLA_IMMEDIATE. It deliberately avoids provider-specific names, registries, headers, and service-report implementation details.
